g.title: MBI_QSP
g.text: Major Thermal Burn Injury — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
one insult · two clocks (leak tau~8 h, hypermetabolism tau~100 d) · a resuscitation controller whose loop gain decays while it works
(18 clusters · 197 nodes · 287 edges · therapy nodes coloured by which TERM of the model they touch)

g.title: cluster_insult
g.text: the zone of stasis is the only one that is still a decision variable

g.title: cluster_starling
g.text: 1 · MICROVASCULAR EXCHANGE — the Starling equation, written per region
Jv = Kf · [ (Pc − Pi) − sigma·(Pi_p − Pi_i) ] · Jprot = Jv·(1−sigma)·Cp + PS·(Cp − Ci)

g.title: cluster_thesis
g.text: MODEL THESIS — three statements the simulation has to earn

g.title: cluster_oncotic
g.text: 2 · COLLOID OSMOTIC PRESSURE — the convexity that makes each litre cost more than the last

g.title: cluster_compart
g.text: 3 · FLUID COMPARTMENTS — where the litres actually go

g.title: cluster_control
g.text: 4 · THE RESUSCITATION CONTROLLER — a closed loop with decaying gain
R(t+1) = R(t)·[1 + g·(UO_target − UO)/UO_target] · loop gain = (dUO/dVP)·f_ret

g.title: cluster_morbid
g.text: 5 · RESUSCITATION MORBIDITY — the price of the fixed point
(everything here is caused by the TREATMENT, not by the burn)

g.title: cluster_haemo
g.text: 6 · HAEMODYNAMICS AND KIDNEY — the ebb and the flow phase

g.title: cluster_inflam
g.text: 7 · STERILE INFLAMMATION — the largest DAMP release in clinical medicine

g.title: cluster_infect
g.text: 8 · IMMUNOPARALYSIS AND INFECTION — the leading cause of late death
(the open wound is both the antigen source and the portal)

g.title: cluster_neuro
g.text: 9 · NEUROENDOCRINE STRESS AXIS — the TRANSDUCER between the wound and the metabolism
this is the layer propranolol acts on; it does not touch the driver

g.title: cluster_hyper
g.text: 10 · HYPERMETABOLISM — the SLOW clock (tau ≈ 100 d, persists 12–24 months)
REE/REE_pred = 1 + Emax · A_open^h/(A50^h + A_open^h) · adrenergic transduction

g.title: cluster_protein
g.text: 11 · MUSCLE PROTEIN — net balance is a DIFFERENCE of two large, separately drugged fluxes
dLBM/dt = S − B (both elevated; a 20 % change in either flips the sign)

g.title: cluster_wound
g.text: 12 · WOUND CLOSURE — the ONLY intervention that removes the driver of the slow clock
A_open(t) is a state variable, and every surgical decision is an input to its ODE

g.title: cluster_pharm
g.text: 13 · PHARMACOLOGY — grouped by WHICH TERM of the model each agent touches
(the model's claim: agents in different groups are not substitutes for one another)

g.title: cluster_pk
g.text: 14 · BURN PHARMACOKINETICS — three alterations whose SIGNS differ for total vs free drug
C_free = fu · C_total ; for a low-extraction drug CL = fu · CL_int, so ↓albumin moves TOTAL but not FREE at steady state

g.title: cluster_inhal
g.text: 15 · INHALATION INJURY — an independent multiplier on both clocks

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: 16 · CLINICAL ENDPOINTS — what the model is scored against

g.title: cluster_pop
g.text: 17 · POPULATIONS — where the same equations take different parameters

g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: LEGEND — therapy colour = which TERM of the model it touches

g.title: CONVER
g.text: under- AND over-resuscitation both do it

g.title: TBSA
g.text: (the ONE number that enters both clocks)

g.title: IMBIB
g.text: tau ≈ 1.5 h — no infusion can win it

g.title: COMPL
g.text: for a few mmHg → massive oedema

g.title: PSPROD
g.text: rises with the same insult as Kf

g.title: PPMASS
g.text: falls by escape, not by dilution

g.title: ALBSYN
g.text: cannot refill the pool for days

g.title: EVLW
g.text: until COP falls or ARDS supervenes

g.title: NAE
g.text: sodium load is the real prescription

g.title: T2
g.text: UO-titrated resuscitation is a closed loop
whose gain is f_ret. Fluid creep is its
Testable: albumin must reduce VOLUME more
than it improves haemodynamics, and IAH
must create a second, positive loop.

g.title: T1
g.text: Pi is CONVEX in protein, so f_ret decays
Testable: in:out ratio must rise over the
24 h even with a fixed protocol.

g.title: OPIOID
g.text: → lower UO at the same VP

g.title: COLLOI
g.text: RAISES f_ret — does not add volume

g.title: ROS
g.text: → the Kf lesion is largely oxidant

g.title: BARRIER
g.text: A_open is the portal of entry

g.title: GROWTH
g.text: height velocity ↓ for up to 2 years

g.title: T3
g.text: Same %TBSA, tau 8 h vs tau 100 d.
The slow clock is driven by A_open(t),
propranolol's benefit must be largest when

g.title: EXCIS2
g.text: the only class that does this

g.title: GLNSUP
g.text: a negative result the model must not hide)
